name: Galaxy-score-z REGIME veto ON the accel-ignition long (overlay ablation) (1d)
rationale: MECHANISM: galaxy_score blends price+social+correlation health into one rank. The internal finding is explicit — the top-decile drawdown asymmetry did NOT robustly replicate and external analysis shows galaxy_score is largely redundant with price/vol — so galaxy_score_z is used ONLY as a low-confidence quality/regime TAG, never a standalone trigger. Here it filters the attention-onset long: take the social_volume_accel spike only when crowd-health z is NOT deteriorating (galaxy_score_z above a fitted floor), aiming to cut false positives from manipulated spikes. DISCONFIRMER: as a standalone directional signal galaxy_score_z is REJECTED on priors — the bar is that spec+galaxy_veto must beat the accel spec ALONE out of sample (ablation). If the veto does not improve net-of-fee OOS Sharpe, drop it; it must not manufacture a winner by cutting trades. Shuffle the attention series; the accel core must still collapse.
catalyst: attention acceleration confirmed by non-deteriorating crowd-health rank
